profile.name: Bean & Brick Coffee
pains: Customers ask the same questions about hours and oat milk all day
Evening calls and messages go unanswered
Posting specials takes time the owner does not have
profile.summary: A neighborhood coffee shop in downtown Frederick that takes card payments through Square and posts specials on Instagram. Most questions arrive after closing.

items.title: Website chat and FAQ
items.why: Customers keep asking about hours, parking and dairy-free options. A chat on your site can answer them while you work the counter.

items.title: AI phone receptionist
items.why: Catering and bulk-order calls come in during the morning rush and go to voicemail.

items.title: Review replies and reputation
items.why: You have 140 Google reviews and replying to each one takes real time.

items.title: Social posts and specials
items.why: Your Instagram goes quiet in busy weeks. Drafted posts would keep it steady.

options.fit_sentence: Free to start and connects to your website and Instagram, so it can answer the same questions in both places.
A stronger tool with more reporting, but at $20 a month it is more than a one-shop cafe needs today.
Cheapest paid option, though its builder is less established, so check it first.
Picks up when you are busy, takes the message and texts it to you.
Can also book orders into a calendar, for a bit more money.
